name: Platinum Vape 510 Cartridge | Subzero Strawberry
description: Cool off with a frosty twist on a classic favorite. Subzero Strawberry blends sweet, juicy strawberry flavor with an icy, refreshing finish that chills every exhale. This balanced hybrid delivers smooth, flavorful clouds that hit crisp and clean — the perfect mix of fruity sweetness and frozen freshness. Whether you’re kicking back or keeping the vibe light, Subzero Strawberry makes every pull feel like a blast of cool air.
